question: India shares about ________ of its land border with Afghanistan.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 106 KM**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India shares a 106-kilomete**r (66 mile) land border with Afghanistan, which is the shortest of all India's neighboring countries.
 
• The **border is located in the state of Jammu and Kashmir**
 
• The India-Afghanistan border is located in a very remote and mountainous region, specifically in the **Wakhan Corridor.**
 
• Due to the ongoing territorial disputes between India and Pakistan, particularly over the regions of Jammu and Kashmir,
 
 
• the actual access to this border has been cut off since the **Partition of India** in 1947.
 
 
 
• The region is under the administration of the **Union Territory of Ladakh** but is effectively not directly accessible due to Pakistan's control over parts of Kashmir.
